name: Rocket Propulsion with Coco
description: This course provides an in-depth study of the fundamentals of rocket propulsion, including thermodynamics of the combustion chamber and nozzle. Students analyze solid, liquid, and hybrid rocket motors and apply propulsion theory to engine performance.

name: Aerodynamics
description: This course explores the principles of aerodynamics and how airflow interacts with wings, airfoils, and other flying bodies. Students study lift, drag, compressible flow, and the aerodynamic considerations used in aircraft and spacecraft design.

name: Spacecraft Design
description: This course covers the principles of spacecraft design, including structures, propulsion, thermal control, and power systems. Students apply systems engineering methods to mission design, orbital mechanics, and payload integration for current and future space missions.

name: Organic Chemistry
description: A survey of carbon based compounds, reaction mechanisms, and lab techniques for synthesis and analysis.

name: CS5610 Web Development
description: Web development for sites that are dynamic, data driven, and interactive. I build with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Next.js, Node and Express, and MongoDB, and deploy every project to the web.

name: CS5520 Mobile Application Development
description: Mobile application development on a modern phone platform: user interface building, touch events, data handling with JSON and SQL, networking, and device features such as GPS and motion sensing. Ends with a professional quality app project.

name: CS5004 Object-Oriented Design
description: A comparative approach to object-oriented programming and design in Java: classes, inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, composition versus inheritance, design patterns, and UML diagrams.

name: CS5200 Database Management Systems
description: Relational database management systems: design theory, SQL, relational algebra, entity-relationship diagrams, normalization, indexing with B-trees, transactions and concurrency, and database security.

name: CS5800 Algorithms
description: Mathematical techniques for the design and analysis of algorithms: asymptotic notation, recurrences, sorting and searching, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, graph algorithms, and NP-completeness.

name: CS6620 Fundamentals of Cloud Computing
description: Fundamentals of cloud computing: virtualization and containers, distributed file systems and object stores, infrastructure as a service, open source cloud platforms, big data platforms, and data center scale systems.

name: CS6510 Advanced Software Development
description: Team-based software development on a large-scale project: process, architecture, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and time to reflect on the work and the process, not only the final product.

name: CS5700 Fundamentals of Computer Networking
description: Network protocols, architectures, and performance: layering, transport and routing, link layer protocols, Ethernet and wireless networks, queuing theory basics, and network security.

name: CS6140 Machine Learning
description: A broad look at machine learning: decision trees, neural networks, probabilistic methods, support vector machines, unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, and how to measure the performance of learning algorithms.

name: CS5100 Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
description: The fundamental problems, theories, and algorithms of artificial intelligence: heuristic search and game trees, constraint satisfaction, knowledge representation and logic, planning, Markov decision processes, and an introduction to machine learning.

name: CS6650 Building Scalable Distributed Systems
description: The essential elements of distributed and concurrent systems, plus engineering principles and hands-on experience with modern technologies for building internet-facing systems that scale at low cost.
